# Production support contract

production-qualified means qualified and maintained for production use on the named installation. It is not a service-level, warranty or support-contract commitment, and it grants no licence entitlement.

| Operation | Support | Installation | Activation | Covers | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rule-based prompt-injection screen (`input-sanitizer`) | production-qualified | core | default | `InputSanitizer`, `SanitizeResult` | Blocks the declared override patterns and allows the probed benign input; its detection rate on injection attacks is not measured or qualified; consults no model. |
| Fact storage and word-overlap retrieval (`fact-retrieval`) | production-qualified | core | default | `GroundTruthStore` | Stores facts verbatim and retrieves them by word overlap; retrieval relevance is not qualified. |
| In-memory vector store plumbing (`vector-store`) | production-qualified | core | default | `InMemoryBackend`, `VectorBackend`, `VectorGroundTruthStore`, `get_vector_backend`, `list_vector_backends`, `register_vector_backend` | Storage and lookup only; embedding and ranking quality are not qualified. |
| Production guard refuses to run without model-backed NLI (`guard-fail-closed`) | production-qualified | core | default | `director_ai.guard` | The guard's verdicts are experimental under production-guard. |
| Compliance report and governance summaries (`compliance-reports`) | production-qualified | core+pro | command | `compliance governance`, `compliance report` | anchor, drift, status and verify-anchors are experimental. |
| Compliance evidence kit (`compliance-evidence-kit`) | production-qualified | core+pro | command | `compliance evidence-kit` | Qualifies the kit's packaging and integrity; the scores and verdicts it packages are not qualified. |
| Evidence packet emission (`evidence-emission`) | production-qualified | core+pro | command | `evidence` | Qualifies the sealed packet and its integrity; its demonstration verdicts use the fast heuristic profile and are not qualified. |
| Evidence packet verification (`evidence-verification`) | production-qualified | core | command | `verify-evidence` | Refuses a packet with one changed byte or a missing member. |
| REST server transport with the production security posture (`rest-server-transport`) | production-qualified | core+pro + `server` | command | `serve`, `/v1/health`, `/v1/live`, `/v1/metrics`, `/v1/ready` | The verdict route /v1/review is experimental under model-scoring. |
| OpenAI-compatible proxy transport (`proxy-transport`) | production-qualified | core+pro + `server` | command | `proxy`, `/health` | The proxy's scored completions are experimental under model-scoring. It exposes no metrics route and applies no rate limit. |
| Model-backed coherence scoring and the five-tier stack (`model-scoring`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `CoherenceScore`, `CoherenceScorer`, `LiteScorer`, `MetaClassifier`, `NLIScorer`, `ScoreCache`, `ScorerBackend`, `ScoringEvidence`, `clear_model_cache`, `get_backend`, `list_backends`, `nli_available`, `register_backend` | Production qualification needs hot-path gates Q and T. |
| ProductionGuard verdicts (`production-guard`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `GuardResult`, `ProductionGuard` | Rests on model-scoring. |
| Lightweight stream guard (`stream-guard`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `StreamGuard`, `streaming_guard`, `director_ai.lite` | Rests on model-scoring. |
| Streaming contradiction halt (`streaming-contradiction-halt`) | experimental | not claimed | opt-in | `AsyncStreamingKernel`, `HaltEvidence`, `HaltMonitor`, `StreamSession`, `StreamingKernel`, `TokenEvent` | Never enabled automatically. |
| Model-backed injection detection (`injection-detection`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `InjectedClaim`, `InjectionDetector`, `InjectionResult` |  |
| PII redaction (`pii-redactor`) | production-qualified | core | default | `director_ai.core.redactor` | Redacts the declared patterns of 8 classes (e-mail addresses, card numbers, US social security numbers, phone numbers, MRN, DOB and NHS identifiers, IBANs, passport numbers, IPv4 addresses); its recall on real data is not measured or qualified; consults no model. The production profile turns it on. Where the compliance trail is installed (core+pro, core+full), its strict construction refuses to start without a durable HMAC secret. |
| Strict audit trail (`audit-trail`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `AuditEntry`, `AuditLog` |  |
| Hybrid keyword and vector retrieval (`hybrid-retrieval`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `HybridBackend` |  |
| Tenant routing (`tenant-routing`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `director_ai.core.tenant` |  |
| Batched review queue (`review-queue`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `ReviewQueue` |  |
| Structured logs and OpenTelemetry (`observability`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `director_ai.core.otel` |  |
| Signed knowledge-base writes (`knowledge-write-signing`) | experimental | not claimed | default | `director_ai.core.kb_write_security` |  |
